classification: handwritten diagnostic only; never install or give to provider

inputs.name: credits_to_post
inputs.description: Exact settlement credits to post for the selected cycle.

discovery.title: Finalize settlement cycle
discovery.summary: Request finalization of an assigned settlement cycle into its related settlement register.

review.when: The selected assigned cycle is draft and unrestricted, its related register is open, complete private sample and exception-note sets are within 16 rows each, validated sample credits equal the requested 1–100 credits, and there is no open blocking exception note.
review.then: Propose finalizing that cycle, posting the requested verified credits, and adding those credits to its related register in one guarded transaction. Completion can occur only after separate execution enablement and a worker are running.
refused: Refuse when any required fact is missing, unknown, changed, or does not meet the settlement policy.
Refuse when either private collection exceeds 16 rows; do not disclose the private cause.
review.human_review: Valid requests of 31–100 credits, or otherwise eligible requests that exceed an automatic-approval cap, require one authorized human approval. Invalid requests remain refused.

examples.scenario: A draft unrestricted cycle has an open related register, validated samples total 30 credits, no open blocking note, and the automatic caps remain available.
examples.result: The valid request may be automatically approved and proposed for guarded completion.

examples.scenario: All validity checks pass and validated samples total 31 credits.
examples.result: The request is valid but requires one authorized human approval.

examples.scenario: A cycle has an open blocking exception note or validated samples do not equal the requested credits.
examples.result: The request is refused without exposing private verification details.
